note: Mapping data for the Atlas (atlas.html). The Atlas drops the real case files (from catalog.json) onto several MAPS; the left rail switches between them. This file carries the editorial metadata each map reads: per-case 'move'/'before'/'after', the lens copy, the move-column copy, the symptom hubs, and the special layouts (body ledger tiers, the two hungers). Layout maths live in atlas.html; the words live here. Case ids match catalog.json. Literal Unicode only — no HTML entities.

lenses.name: The Crossing
lenses.intro: Every case is the same motion: from the comfortable, unfree default to the owned, exposed self. Grouped by the move, not the series — so the same evasion at four different altitudes lines up in one column.

lenses.name: By Symptom
lenses.intro: Not chapters — complaints. Start from what you actually feel, and follow it to the cases that read it plainly. One symptom pulls cases from across the series.

lenses.name: The Curriculum
lenses.intro: The whole site as one building, raised from the ground up — four series, each a floor, each case a room. The reading order, honestly labelled as one view among several.

lenses.name: The Body's Ledger
lenses.intro: The self runs on a physical engine. The hardware cases stack from the baseline up; the character cases float above — because a shortage down here arrives disguised as who you are.

lenses.name: The Two Hungers
lenses.intro: The brain keeps two systems: the one that chases and the one that enjoys. The engineered cravings live in the gap between them — maximum pull, minimum payoff.

avoidance.title: The Cage
avoidance.note: The comfortable, unfree default — the trap dressed as safety. The same evasion at every altitude.

craving.title: The Gap
craving.note: Maximum pull, minimum payoff. Wanting mistaken for needing.

substrate.title: The Engine
substrate.note: The hardware the self runs on. Suspect the machine before you indict the self.

ground.title: The Open Field
ground.note: Built, owned, exposed. The self raised on solid ground.

symptoms.q: Nothing I get ever feels like enough.
I cannot sit with a craving.
My moods swing and I cannot say why.
Life feels like it just happens to me.
I keep numbing out or looking away.
I cannot let go of what is already over.
I do not know what any of it is for.

left.label: Wanting
left.note: The 'go get it' pull — loud, forward-leaning, easily hijacked.

right.label: Liking
right.note: The actual payoff — quiet, small, quick to fade.

exit.label: The Pause
exit.note: Wanting fades if it is not fed. That half-second is the whole of the freedom.
